instruction: Complete the task entirely in the Abaqus/CAE graphical user interface. Analyze thermal bending of a cantilever plate in the N-mm-MPa unit system. Create a 3D deformable solid plate spanning X = 0 to 100 mm, Y = 0 to 20 mm, and Z = 0 to 4 mm. Partition it at Y = 10 mm so the upper and lower halves are separate cell regions. Define Aluminum with E = 70000 MPa, nu = 0.33, and thermal expansion coefficient 2.3e-5 /K; assign a solid homogeneous section to the whole plate. Create one dependent instance and a Static, General step named Step-ThermalBend. Apply Encastre only to the X = 0 end. Apply an initial temperature of 20 degC to the whole plate. In Step-ThermalBend, set only the upper half, Y = 10 to 20 mm, to 120 degC; the lower half must remain at 20 degC. Create named sets FIXED_END and HOT_HALF. Mesh with C3D8R elements and a 4 mm global seed. Create and run Job-ThermalBend. Review U2 at the free end and the S11 bending-stress distribution. Save C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-ThermalBend.cae and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-ThermalBend.odb.
